mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, u.nick_name AS user_nick_name, r.status, r.assigned_admin_id, a.nick_name AS assigned_admin_nick_name, (SELECT LEFT(m.content, 60) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_id = r.id ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message, r.last_message_at, r.created_at, r.restricted_until, COALESCE(r.restricted_until > NOW(), FALSE) AS restricted
FROM chat_room r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = r.assigned_admin_id
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET status = 'WAITING', assigned_admin_id = NULL WHERE id = #{roomId} AND status = 'CLOSED' AND (restricted_until IS NULL OR restricted_until <= NOW())
UPDATE chat_room SET restricted_until = NULL WHERE id = #{roomId}
UPDATE chat_room SET status = 'ACTIVE', assigned_admin_id = #{adminId} WHERE id = #{roomId} AND status = 'WAITING'
UPDATE chat_room SET assigned_admin_id = #{toAdminId} WHERE id = #{roomId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND assigned_admin_id <=> #{fromAdminId}
UPDATE chat_room SET status = 'CLOSED' WHERE id = #{roomId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM chat_room WHERE assigned_admin_id = #{adminId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET status = 'WAITING', assigned_admin_id = NULL WHERE assigned_admin_id = #{adminId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id, sender_type, sender_id, content) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_message_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id, sender_type, sender_id, content, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE id = #{messageId}
SELECT u.id, u.nick_name, aa.role FROM admin_accounts aa JOIN users u ON u.id = aa.user_id ORDER BY aa.role DESC, u.nick_name
